entries.title: Job 32:1
segments:
. SPEECH OF ELIHU. 
 
    1-6. Prose (poetry begins with "I am young"). 
 
    because, &c.--and because they could not prove to him that he was unrighteous.

entries.title: Job 32:2
segments: 2. Elihu--meaning "God is Jehovah." In his name and character as messenger between God and Job, he foreshadows Jesus Christ (
, Job denies that man can be more just than God. UMBREIT translates, "Before (in the presence of) God."

entries.title: Job 32:3
segments: 3. Though silenced in argument, they held their opinion still.

entries.title: Job 32:4
segments: 4. had spoken--Hebrew, "in words," referring rather to his own "words" of reply, which he had long ago ready, but kept back in deference to the seniority of the friends who spoke.

entries.title: Job 32:6
segments: 6. was afraid--The root meaning in Hebrew is "to crawl" (

entries.title: Job 32:7
segments: 7. Days--that is, the aged (

entries.title: Job 32:8
segments: 8. Elihu claims inspiration, as a divinely commissioned messenger to Job (
); and that claim is not contradicted in
. Translate: "But the spirit (which God puts) in man, and the inspiration ... is that which giveth," &c.; it is not mere "years" which give understanding (

entries.title: Job 32:9
segments: 9. Great--rather, "old" (
). So Hebrew, in

. "Greater, less" for the older, the younger. 
 
    judgment--what is right.

entries.title: Job 32:10
segments:
10. Rather, "I say." 
 
    opinion--rather, "knowledge."

entries.title: Job 32:11
segments:
11. Therefore Elihu was present from the first. 
 
    reasons--literally, "understandings," that is, the meaning intended by words. 
 
    whilst--I waited until you should discover a suitable reply to Job.

entries.title: Job 32:13
segments: 13. This has been so ordered, "lest you should" pride yourselves on having overcome him by your "wisdom" (

, the great aim of the Book of Job); and that you may see, "God alone can thrust him down," that is, confute him, "not man." So Elihu grounds his confutation, not on the maxims of sages, as the friends did, but on his special commission from God (

entries.title: Job 32:14
segments: 14. I am altogether unprejudiced. For it is not I, whom he addressed. "Your speeches" have been influenced by irritation.

entries.title: Job 32:15
segments: 15. Here Elihu turns from the friends to Job: and so passes from the second person to the third; a transition frequent in a rebuke (

). 
 
    they left off--Words were taken from them.

entries.title: Job 32:17
segments:
17. my part--for my part. 
 
    opinion--knowledge.

entries.title: Job 32:18
segments:
18. "I am full of words," whereas the friends have not a word more to say. 
 
    the spirit-- (

entries.title: Job 32:19
segments: 19. belly--bosom: from which the words of Orientalists in speaking seem to come more than with us; they speak gutturally. "Like (new) wine (in fermentation) without a vent," to work itself off. New wine is kept in new goatskin bottles. This fittingly applies to the young Elihu, as contrasted with the old friends (

entries.title: Job 32:20
segments: 20. refreshed--literally, "that there may be air to me" (

entries.title: Job 32:21
segments: 21. "May I never accept," &c. Elihu alludes to Job's words (

), wherein he complains that the friends plead for God partially, "accepting His person." Elihu says he will not do so, but will act impartially between God and Job. "And I will not give flattery," &c. (

entries.title: Job 32:22
segments: 22. take me away--as a punishment (
